messages:
Irene: Found three tiny snowglobes in the supply closet. Apparently someone donated them to the office holiday spirit. They’re fragile but adorable. Anyone want to adopt one? (pic attached)
Ben: I will absolutely adopt one if it comes with a tiny stand and a name. :snowflake:
Kara: If one is llama-themed I claim immediate dibs. Otherwise I’ll settle for the one with glitter. :llama:
Hugo: Quick poll: React :one: take home, :two: keep on communal shelf, :three: raffle it at the cocoa table.
Lily: :two: communal shelf so more people see them. Also we need a tiny display sign.
Ben: :one: my desk is very accepting of small, tasteful kitsch.
Irene: Poll so far: 1 vote take home, 1 vote shelf. I'll leave them on the kitchen counter for viewing until 3pm.
Kara: Also PSA: last year someone’s cat knocked over the glitter globe and we still find shards in the plants. Please place away from edges. :cat2:
holiday-bot: Reminder: Fragile items left on common counters are placed in Lost & Found after Friday 5pm. Please label if you intend to keep them. :package:
Hugo: If nobody claims the llama-themed one by 3:30 I’ll buy it a tiny sweater and adopt.
Lily: Proposal: tiny name suggestions thread. My vote: "Blizzard Bink" for the sparkly one.
Ben: I like Blizzard Bink. For the plain one: "Desk Frost". For the odd one with a tiny tree: "Branch Manager". :deciduous_tree:
Kara: Branch Manager is chef's kiss. Also I’m team raffle if others want a fair chance.
Irene: Okay final plan: communal shelf until 3pm, then raffle at the cocoa table at 12:15, and remaining unclaimed ones go to Lost & Found at 5pm. If you want to be entered in raffle but can’t be there, DM me.
Ben: Dropping my name in the raffle list. Also bringing extra coffee cups for the raffle crowd.
Kara: DM sent. If I win I vow to put the globe on a pedestal and not let it near the ficus.
Hugo: Small addendum: if anyone brings pet-safe glitter, do not share with office plants. Learned that one the hard way. :grimacing:
Lily: Raffle note: please only one entry per person so it's fair.
Irene: Raffle at 12:15. See you at cocoa. And yes there will be photos of the tiny winners. :camera_with_flash:
